name: CAMELYON17: Patient-Level Breast Cancer Lymph Node Metastasis Benchmark
description: CAMELYON17 is the successor digital pathology challenge to CAMELYON16, shifting the clinical objective from individual lesion detection to automated patient-level pathological nodal (pN) staging in breast cancer. Sourced from five independent pathology laboratories across the Netherlands (Radboudumc, UMC Utrecht, Rijnstate Hospital, Canisius-Wilhelmina Hospital, and Laboratorium Pathologie Oost-Nederland), the dataset provides 1,000 whole-slide images (WSIs) across 200 patients (5 sentinel lymph node sections per patient). With 500 slides provided for training (including exhaustive annotations for 50 slides and patient pN-stage labels) and 500 slides for independent testing, CAMELYON17 rigorously benchmarks multi-center algorithmic robustness and clinical staging accuracy.

license.name: Conflicting: CC0 1.0 (Data Portal & GigaDB) vs CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (Download) vs Challenge Rules
license.notes: Conflicting terms exist across official channels: The /Data/ portal, GigaScience Database (DOI: 10.5524/100439), and AWS Open Data Registry designate the collection under CC0 1.0; however, the /Download/ portal explicitly licenses the files under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, while Challenge Rules govern participation and submission rights. Commercial permissions are unresolved and recorded as unknown.
